title: Wiemer intro
description: A product introduction on near-white: an orange mono tag, a huge two-line greeting at the left edge, then a narrow text column on the right third (a subline, short paragraphs and an arrow link), and below it a full-bleed row of tall 4:5 grey product cards. Letters of the greeting and subline rise out of their lines as they scroll in, paragraphs rise, and the card row slides sideways with the scroll.
notes: cards are 4:5 media slots; empty ones are muted placeholders
CSS scroll-driven; without support the row simply sits still, cropped at the right
